common_rule: 18 isolated Luna high searches,6 each T/F/U; broad concrete mathematics; 36 independent opposing Luna high critics; Sol high adjudication and synthesis. Primary unchanged;94 inherited refutations binding. No agents, Lean builds, background jobs or self-awards. Finite computations do not settle universal targets.

routes.T1: Early-to-current marked occupancy transfer CT_x, using size-conditioned hard-core measures, exact double counting, coupling, or quantitative tilt. Positive covariance occurs on eligible trees; prove a budget, not a false negative-correlation shortcut. Seek a genuine global step with explicit hypotheses.
routes.T2: Weaker flat addability budget E<=(x+1)Q, or directly E-C<=(p-1)Q. Treat E<=(p-1)Q as a separate sufficient intermediate. Obtain structural cancellation across leaf tags and exploit favorable inequalities; do not merely restate the target identity.
routes.T3: Mixed boundary on CB colored matching-edge sectors: ordinary subset shadow plus support insertion, actual branch blocks, arbitrary source subsets and competing lower capacity. Use extremal set theory/compression only with a proved bridge to weighted cuts. Target CB92/93 or all-parameter tractable subcase.
routes.T4: Construct an aggregate operator or matching that mixes leaf tags. Relative independence complexes, graded modules, discrete Morse maps or chain decompositions are allowed. Every-leaf/block-diagonal injectivity is already impossible T22. Specify a well-defined global map and exact missing property, not a dimension tautology.
routes.T5: Infinite T_m family: exploit exact P/Q derivative identity and coefficient ratios to absorb the positive arm through negative claw contributions for ALL eligible m,p. Check both leaf-orbit selectors. The registered r19 ratio package is optional, not a forced route; no full-tree log-concavity or real-rootedness assumption. Explicitly derive both orbit selector polynomials and state which complete case is proved; finite mass estimates are not uniform coefficient bounds.
routes.T6: Rooted-tree polynomial/selector recurrences with boundary states: seek a genuine compositional invariant sufficient for the full aggregate, stable under a precisely stated gluing operation. Preserve strict selector changes and root-as-leaf term. Verify complete leaves from edges.
routes.F1: Attack CT_x with heterogeneous, deeply branched, asymmetric trees and proper favorable selectors; freeze modest exact protocols and distinguish no proper-selector samples from successful stress. Supply entire eligible witness if found, and distinguish bridge failure from S>0. Every sampled eligible row records whether F is a proper subset of original leaves; report that count, including zero. If no proper selector exists in your sample, investigate the precise obstruction without claiming impossibility.
routes.F2: Attack the weaker flat/current addability budgets separately, not just CT_x. Use local graft changes, degree profiles and adversarial parameter searches; classify which rung fails and compute E,C,Q,S exactly. Report Q,E,C,U,S,i_x,i_(x+1), all three budget gaps and original leaf inventory for any candidate witness.
routes.F3: Attack mixed weighted Hall on enlarged deletion-plus-two-for-one relation: asymmetric versions of CB or T_m, orbit reductions only with verified lift. A negative complete sum does not certify all cuts. Seek exact cut certificate or rigorous bottleneck, not a loose envelope.
routes.F4: Test proposed selector/recurrence invariants and root boundary handling with complete graph-derived leaves and an independently written count method. Include changed selector membership, not only all-leaves-favorable rows. Test fixed-support multiplicity and terminal differences.
routes.F5: Attack all-parameter T_m analytic inequalities near orbit mode boundaries, small m, endpoint p, and large m. Separate exact inequalities from saddle-point approximations and means from modes. New unequal-claw/lopsided variant should test mechanism robustness.
routes.F6: First/second/third-shell boundary falsification: especially n2p4,p10..13, where the cover>=7 premise is already false; seek failure of actual pointwise sign or strengthen low-cover classification. No repetition of the refuted cover threshold. Preserve main aggregate separately.
routes.U1: Quantitative covariance reformulation of CT_x: exact weighted same-tree rank-p identities, useful domination parameter, and a check of what first strict descent actually controls. No universal ratio monotonicity assumption. Distinguish sufficient bridges from equivalent target.
routes.U2: General marked shell reduction using cover loss and existing r25 matching thresholds; identify exact finite residual base cases and where Catalan cover exclusion ceases to help (s5). Prioritize a reusable lemma rather than endless individual shells.
routes.U3: Low-cover skeleton representation for n2p4,p10..13: prove completeness and obtain a bounded reproducible parameter census plan or symbolic sign strategy. With six-cover, outside connector excess <=5; account for cover vertices that are original leaves. Do not launch a large unbounded census.
routes.U4: Literature-informed colored quotient rings / normalized matching / multigraded shadow audit: identify the exact theorem usable in CB's matching sector and prove or refute preservation of the mixed boundary under a concrete compression. Literature is input, not an automatic weighted-Hall award.
routes.U5: Boundary-state tree decomposition/finite algebra for selector-dependent aggregate: formal language or transfer-matrix lens, identify minimal state information and an explicit induction bottleneck. Rank is global and selection changes under deletion, so naive local additivity is inadmissible.
routes.U6: First-shell formal proof mathematical bridge audit plus scale-up assessment: inspect new formal integration helpers for exact induced-graph/cardinality/cover semantics; isolate reusable lemma connecting informal proof to canonical definitions. No Lean builds in route; no reopening immutable awards. If routine, spend remainder on first nontrivial global dependency beyond finite shells. Use frozen BASE.lean and preflight, first-shell contract and informal audit; live producer outputs are forbidden. Canonical existing matching5 third-band result is inherited, not new.
